units.source_text: 附在葵姬身上的生灵答道：“否否，非为此也。

en.t: The living spirit attached to Lady Aoi answered, "No, no, that is not why I am here.

units.source_text: 我全身异常痛苦，欲请法师稍稍宽恕耳。

en.t: My whole body is in terrible pain, and I only wish to ask the priest to show me a little mercy.

units.source_text: 我绝非有意来此相扰，只因忧思郁结，魂灵不能守舍，浮游飘荡，偶尔至此也。

en.t: I certainly did not come here on purpose to disturb anyone; it is only because sorrow and longing have gathered inside me, so that my spirit could not remain in my body, but drifted about and happened to come here.
" Her tone was gentle and approachable, and she then recited a poem:
